issues.issue: Was the applicant denied procedural fairness?
issues.applicant_position: She had no notice that the genuineness of her marriage would be the focus; this breached procedural fairness.
issues.respondent_position: She was told by letter and at the interview of the concerns about misrepresentation, so she had notice.
issues.result_quote: I cannot accept that the applicant was unaware her marriage would be scrutinized at the interview.

issues.issue: Did the manager err in finding that the applicant misrepresented her marital status?
issues.applicant_position: Manager applied section 40 without first making a bad-faith marriage finding under section 4 IRPR; evidence not fully weighed.
issues.respondent_position: Misrepresentation finding is reasonable; genuineness of the marriage was material and rested on all the evidence.
issues.result_quote: As a result, I conclude the manager was not guided by the proper legal considerations and committed a reviewable error
